PRIMING AS PROCESSING SKIPPED, NOT PROCESSING SPED UP. `A direct association forms between the stimulus presented and the response made to it. On a subsequent encounter with the stimulus, this association automatically cues the response, BYPASSING the various processing stages that were required to select that response during its first presentation.` That is a different claim from facilitation and from sharpening, and it makes a prediction neither does: change the response and the saving disappears

REPETITION SUPPRESSION IS NOT ONE THING, and this is the record that splits it: `a dissociation between RS within the PFC, which may be sensitive to retrieval of stimulus-response associations, and RS within posterior perceptual regions, which may reflect facilitation of perceptual pr[ocessing]`. Two regions, two mechanisms, one name. Gotts2012 reviews four candidate mechanisms as though the phenomenon were unitary; here it is divided by anatomy and each half takes a different explanation
THE artifact IS TIME-LOCKED TO THE BEHAVIOURAL VARIABLE OF INTEREST: lick-response-induced brain motion was the major obstacle, and licking happens at reward, which happens after the target
up to 15 micrometers of sinking as the animal opens its jaw, which a single plane would have recorded as an artifactual fluorescence change
THE CORRECTION DECIDES THE FINDING: standard two-dimensional correction removes the motion that is NOT lick-related, and only three-dimensional correction removes the motion that is

A CLASS ASSIGNED BY A PROXY FEATURE, CRITICISED BY NAME: the few studies that related behavioral modulation to cell type all inferred cellular identity from extracellular spike waveforms, WHICH HAS LIMITED SCOPE AND RELIABILITY
and the motivating problem is that the modulation of nearby neurons is heterogeneous IN MAGNITUDE AND EVEN IN DIRECTION, so a population average hides opposite effects
THE THRESHOLD IS NOT A PROPERTY OF THE ANIMAL ALONE: absolute orientation thresholds likely depend on the incidence of presentation of each stimulus, and on the task structure
and the ceiling of the discriminability measure is set by truncating the rates at 0.01 and 0.99, giving a maximum of 4.65 that belongs to the arithmetic and not to the mouse
THE DEMONSTRATION SESSION IS NOT THE TYPICAL SESSION, AND THE PAPER SAYS SO: the performance in the two imaging figures was below the trained level, in that mouse and even in that session
with about half the mice tested learning the task at all
THE SAMPLED POPULATION DEPENDS ON THE LABEL: the synthetic dye loads every cell in a local volume, while the genetically encoded indicator labels only a subset
A behaviorAL CONTROL THAT SHOWS THE ASSOCIATION IS NOT REFLEXIVE: mice stop licking when the spout is withdrawn, and the discrimination does not extinguish when it returns
and the same neurons give the same orientation preference during the behavior and during passive viewing, which is what licenses comparing the two

THE NEURAL INDEX IS A SEMANTIC-VIOLATION MARKER, WHICH IS A STRONGER CLAIM THAN A SLOWDOWN: a colour-modified fruit `should yield a SEMANTIC VIOLATION as indexed by an increase in N400 amplitude`, and it does. The behavioural half says the concept is harder to reach; the N400 says the modified image is treated as semantically WRONG for its category, which is what distinguishes an integral feature from a merely useful one
P2 and P2p are DIFFERENT components separated in time and space, despite names differing by one letter; P2p indexes the DE and P2 does not
anterior N1 and posterior N1 are different components with different generators; this study evokes the anterior one where the cited precedent evoked the posterior
SES is a composite score built from parental education, occupation and household resources by item response theory and principal components, not a single measured quantity

THE TITLE SAYS `IMPAIRS` AND THE RESULT IS A REVERSAL. `Participants in the UST group chose the faces that were shown 12 times significantly more, WHILE THOSE IN THE IMT GROUP WERE MORE LIKELY TO CHOOSE FACES PRESENTED ONCE.` Told the choice is unspecified, people pick what they have seen most; told it matters, they pick what they have seen LEAST. An instruction that inverts a preference is a stronger finding than one that removes it, and the abstract's verb understates the result
and the anatomy points away too: IN HUMANS, CORTICAL CIRCUITS UNDERLYING AUDITORY PERCEPTION AND COGNITION ARE LARGELY FOUND IN LATERAL, RATHER THAN MEDIAL TEMPORAL LOBE STRUCTURES

and the conclusion follows from the widening rather than from new data: IN LIGHT OF THIS EXTENDED PROPOSED FUNCTIONAL SCOPE, A FULL ACCOUNT OF THE AUDITORY SYSTEM SHOULD AT LEAST CONSIDER THE HIPPOCAMPUS

A DISAGREEMENT BETWEEN STUDIES ATTRIBUTED TO ONE PARAMETER OF THE ANALYSIS: DIFFERENCES ACROSS THE RESULTS OF THESE STUDIES MAY RELATE TO THE THRESHOLDS USED IN THE PROBABILISTIC TRACTOGRAPHY PROCEDURE

AND A DEFINITION IMPORTED FROM ANOTHER SENSE: AN AUDITORY PERCEPTUAL OBJECT, LIKE ITS VISUAL COUNTERPARTS, IS DEFINED BY THE BINDING OF MULTIPLE SENSORY FEATURES, REPRESENTS A SOURCE DISTINCT FROM OTHERS IN THE SCENE, AND IS INVARIANT OVER DIFFERENT SENSORY INSTANCES
A STRUCTURAL CORRELATION WHOSE CAUSAL READING IS WITHHELD: LONGITUDINAL STUDIES, SIMILAR TO THOSE IN TAXI DRIVERS, WILL BE IMPORTANT TO ESTABLISH CAUSALITY IN ANY OF THE ABOVE RELATIONSHIPS

THE FINDING CITED FOR A STRUCTURE WAS MEASURED IN A DIFFERENT ONE, AND THE REVIEW SAYS SO IN A PARENTHESIS: THE VOLUME OF PARAHIPPOCAMPAL GYRUS (HIPPOCAMPUS WAS NOT TESTED) WAS FOUND TO CORRELATE POSITIVELY WITH AN INDEX OF MUSICAL SOPHISTICATION IN A GROUP OF 73 OLDER ADULTS AFTER CONTROLLING FOR INTRACRANIAL VOLUME
and the positive associations that do exist are with training time: POSITIVE RELATIONSHIPS BETWEEN YEARS OF TRAINING AND ANTERIOR HIPPOCAMPAL GRAY MATTER VOLUME IN MUSICIANS AND PIANO-TUNERS

A CLINICAL EFFECT THAT DEPENDS ON THE TIMING AND NOT THE SOUND: CLICK TRAINS PRESENTED AT THIS RATE (BUT NOT WITH RANDOM TIMING) REDUCED SIGNS OF ALZHEIMER'S PATHOLOGY (AMYLOID LOAD AND TAU PHOSPHORYLATION) IN THE HIPPOCAMPUS OF THIS MOUSE MODEL AND BOOSTED MEMORY FOR THE IDENTITY AND LOCATION OF OBJECTS
A CONFOUND REMOVED BY MOVING THE RESPONSE: BY HAVING SUBJECTS REPORT TARGET COUNTS AT THE END OF A TRIAL OR BLOCK, EXPLICIT MOTOR CONFOUNDS ARE REMOVED

and the review names what is still not known: IT REMAINS TO BE DETERMINED WHETHER SOUNDS PREDICTED ON THE BASIS OF ASSOCIATIONS LEARNED IN THE SHORT-TERM OR THROUGH SEMANTIC CONTEXT CAN BE DECODED FROM HIPPOCAMPAL ACTIVITY BEFORE THEY ARE HEARD
AND THE AUTHORS RE-RAN IT: the reported statistic was replaced with a paired Wilcoxon sign-rank test on the same data, and the conclusion survived

THE SAME RESULT SAID PLAINLY, in the authors' own restatement

A NEGATIVE RESULT ABOUT INHIBITION: changes made by PV interneurons in cortex do not reach the colliculus
THE FIELD'S DEFAULT IS ASCENDING: descending feedback is described as routinely overlooked
A ROBUSTNESS CHECK AGAINST A SELECTION ARTEFACT: the DCIC result is re-run on rate-matched units in case a few high-firing units carried it
TWO MECHANISMS FOR ONE OBSERVATION ARE LEFT OPEN: direct activation and disinhibition are not equivalent, which is offered as why the interneuron result differs
the analysed effect sample is conditioned on the dependent variable: respondents answering No to having experienced any change were sent straight to the end of the survey
improvement is a single retrospective cursor position from -100 to +100, not a repeated clinical measure, and the OCI-r was collected only at survey time

A DEFINING CRITERION THAT SURVIVED ITS OWN REFUTATION: the pre-categorical nature is one of the three characteristics that define iconic memory, and evidence has since shown the system is NOT entirely pre-categorical

A CAPACITY THAT WAS NEVER OBSERVED, ONLY EXTRAPOLATED: subjects recalled three or four letters in the full report and about 75% of a cued row, and the large capacity follows by EXTRAPOLATING the partial report to the total

THE CLASS IS characterizeD BY ITS BEST-STUDIED MEMBER: research focused on iconic memory, the other two sensory types are comparatively scarce, and iconic memory is therefore presented as the paradigm of the class
ONE REFERENT, TWO NAMES, WRITTEN AS A PARENTHESIS: declarative memory (explicit) and non-declarative memory (implicit/procedural)
A DISTINCTION RENAMED ACROSS A CENTURY: James in 1890 distinguished primary from secondary memory, THEREBY REFERRING TO short- and long-term memory

THE FIELD'S FIRST RESPONSE TO A FALSIFYING CASE WAS TO QUARANTINE IT: the patient learned a skill without remembering the task, and discussions at the time SET ASIDE motor skills as a special case, keeping the rest of memory of one piece
A GLOSSARY THAT DISCLAIMS ITSELF: the commentary is NOT INTENDED AS AN EXHAUSTIVE DEFINITION, only enough to situate the reader in a complex panorama
A DOUBLE DISSOCIATION BORROWED FROM TWO GENETIC SYNDROMES: Williams patients keep language and Down patients keep more spatial capacity, and each does better on the matching task
ONE EVENT LAID DOWN TWICE: the same childhood accident consolidates as a declarative memory of the event and crystallises separately as a phobia
with the gap named exactly: in ALMOST ALL previous studies comparing anesthetized and awake states, ONLY THE LEMNISCAL IC CORE WAS INVESTIGATED

THE STANDARD STATISTIC DOES NOT EXIST FOR THIS DATA TYPE, AND THE RESULT IS DOWNGRADED ACCORDINGLY: Rayleigh statistics and vector strength are NOT APPLICABLE to calcium imaging, so the temporal differences are SUGGESTIVE BUT SHOULD NOT BE TAKEN AS CONCLUSIVE EVIDENCE
AN ANATOMICAL LABEL THAT CANNOT BE VERIFIED: no reliable histological proof could differentiate the two candidate subregions, so the site is reported as what they were PROBABLY recording from

TWO PUBLISHED MECHANISMS FOR THE SAME EFFECT, IN CONTRADICTION, AND THE PAPER MARKS IT: one group reports disinhibition through VIP and somatostatin cells, another found ALL inhibitory and excitatory neurons excited, CHALLENGING THE DISINHIBITION MODEL
AND THE SIGN OF THE SAME MANIPULATION DEPENDS ON THE MODALITY: locomotion DECREASES response gains in auditory cortex and INCREASES them in visual cortex
THE POPULATION RESULT HIDES A QUARTER GOING THE OTHER WAY: locomotion narrows the spectral bandwidth overall, and 48% of excitatory neurons increased selectivity while 24% DECREASED it
AND GAIN AND SELECTIVITY COME APART: locomotion does NOT affect the response gain of either cell type, while selectivity of excitatory neurons is significantly increased
THE CELL-TYPE RULE IS OPPOSITE TO THE ONE IN CORTEX: in cortex the excitatory neurons are the selective ones, and here the INHIBITORY neurons have the narrower spectral bandwidth in both states
with the selectivity proposed to be INHERITED from ascending brainstem input rather than computed locally

THE PAPER SHIPS ITS OWN GLOSSARY, AND THE FIRST ENTRY LEAVES A PROPERTY UNDETERMINED: a cell assembly is a group of neurons that transiently co-activate, and RECIPROCAL CONNECTIVITY BETWEEN GROUP MEMBERS MAY OR MAY NOT BE IMPLIED

the definition of phase precession is extended past its original object: initially described in place cells, it has also been reported in interneurons, episode and sound-responsive cells, IN WHICH CASE THE MOVEMENT IS CONSIDERED IN A MORE ABSTRACT SPACE

A DISAGREEMENT BETWEEN TWO OTHER PAPERS, WITH THE PARAMETER IT TURNS ON, STATED BY A THIRD: the apparent inconsistency with the results of one study MAY STEM FROM THE LIMITED NUMBER OF REPLAY EVENTS EXAMINED in the other

THE DATA CANNOT SEPARATE THE THEORIES, SAID PLAINLY: the same studies support the interference models and also report the critical prediction of the rival models, and because a third class can account for the same findings IT BECOMES UNCLEAR WHETHER INTRACELLULAR DATA DO DISCRIMINATE between different classes of models

A REINTERPRETATION THAT REMOVES EVIDENCE FROM A HYPOTHESIS WITHOUT NEW DATA: the independent coding model IS SUFFICIENT TO REPLICATE THE DATA PREVIOUSLY INTERPRETED AS EVIDENCE FOR THE COORDINATED ASSEMBLY HYPOTHESIS

ONE FINDING UNDERMINING A WHOLE FRAMEWORK: a novel form of synaptic potentiation at the behavioral timescale could store entire sequences of events seconds before and after, which EFFECTIVELY UNDERMINES THE THEORETICAL FRAMEWORK that theta sequences are REQUIRED to bring spike trains into temporal proximity

THREE CAUSAL STUDIES, THREE CONFOUNDS SUPPLIED BY THE REVIEWERS RATHER THAN BY THE ORIGINAL AUTHORS. First: the drug that impaired the task also DECREASES RIPPLE POWER, so the deficit could come from altered activity during awake ripples instead
second: one cannot entirely rule out that the deficits were DIRECTLY DUE TO DISRUPTION OF THETA OSCILLATIONS, given an 80% decrease in theta power

with the size of the evidence base stated: ONLY THREE STUDIES have reported task performance deficits linked to a degradation of theta sequences, because interfering with theta sequences is challenging

A WHOLE TECHNIQUE CRITICISED ON TIMING GROUNDS: tagging studies ARTIFICIALLY ACTIVATE NEURONS IN A HYPER-SYNCHRONOUS MANNER and NEGLECT ANY FINE-TIMESCALE TEMPORAL INFORMATION, and because the labeling window RANGES FROM SEVERAL HOURS TO DAYS the tagged population is likely to include numerous irrelevant neurons

A NUMBER THAT LOOKS LIKE 360 DEGREES ONLY BECAUSE OF POOLING: the range may APPEAR TO SPAN AS MUCH AS 360 degrees WHEN POOLING DATA OVER MULTIPLE FIELD CROSSINGS, while single-trial phase range is typically about 180 and NEVER EXCEEDS A FULL CYCLE
and then past space altogether: phase precession MAY NOT BE UNIQUELY LINKED TO SPACE, but rather to the full episodic component of the ongoing experience

and a prediction credited in a footnote, retrospectively: in its UNCORRECTED version, this model PREDICTED THAT PLACE CELLS SHOULD FIRE IN REGULAR SPATIAL PATTERNS LONG BEFORE THE DISCOVERY OF GRID CELLS

THE CONCLUSION KEEPS THE QUESTION OPEN: a notable fraction of theta cycles CONTAIN NON-CANONICAL ACTIVITY, INCLUDING SEEMINGLY RANDOM NOISE AND EVEN REVERSE SEQUENCES, and IT REMAINS CURRENTLY UNCLEAR WHICH SPECIFIC FUNCTIONS ARE SUSTAINED BY THETA SEQUENCES, AWAKE REPLAY, OR BOTH

THE GAP BETWEEN A CORRELATE AND A ROLE, STATED IN THE FIRST SENTENCE: NUMEROUS BRAIN REGIONS HAVE BEEN SHOWN TO HAVE NEURAL CORRELATES OF GRADUALLY ACCUMULATING EVIDENCE FOR DECISION-MAKING, BUT THE CAUSAL ROLES OF THESE REGIONS IN DECISIONS DRIVEN BY ACCUMULATION OF EVIDENCE HAVE YET TO BE DETERMINED

AND THE TEST RETURNS NULL WHERE THE CORRELATE IS STRONGEST, WITH THE AUTHORS' REACTION IN THE TEXT: GIVEN THE VIEW THAT THE PPC PLAYS A KEY CAUSAL ROLE IN RODENT PERCEPTUAL DECISIONS AND THAT NEURAL ACTIVITY IN PPC DISPLAYS CORRELATES OF ACCUMULATING AUDITORY EVIDENCE, WE WERE SURPRISED TO FIND THAT UNILATERAL INACTIVATION OF THE PPC DID NOT CAUSE A SIDE BIAS

and the obvious escape route is closed by experiment, not by argument: COMPENSATION FROM THE UNPERTURBED HEMISPHERE DID NOT EXPLAIN THE LACK OF AN EFFECT, BECAUSE BILATERAL INACTIVATION OF THE PPC CAUSED A MINIMAL DECREASE IN PERFORMANCE (3.6%) THAT WAS NOT SIGNIFICANTLY DIFFERENT FROM UNILATERAL INACTIVATIONS
and the conclusion about both regions is itself a negative: NEITHER REGION APPEARS LIKELY TO PLAY A MAJOR CAUSAL ROLE IN THE GRADUAL EVIDENCE ACCUMULATION PROCESS PER SE
with the scope of the positive claim bounded in the next clause: DECISIONS WITH SHORTER PROCESSING TIMES MAY INVOLVE CIRCUITS THAT BYPASS THE FOF

and the positive result agrees with a 2000 microstimulation study while going further: OUR RESULTS IN RAT FOF ARE CONSISTENT WITH THOSE OF GOLD AND SHADLEN, BUT GO CONSIDERABLY FURTHER IN SPECIFICALLY SUGGESTING THE FOF AS A REQUISITE PREMOTOR COMPONENT OF THE OUTPUT PATHWAY OF A LONG TIME CONSTANT (>0.24 s) EVIDENCE ACCUMULATOR
A SPECIFICITY ARGUMENT MADE FROM WHAT THE NEIGHBOUR DOES: THE EFFECTS OBSERVED ARE MORE LIKELY DUE TO CHANGES IN FOF RATHER THAN AN ADJACENT CORTICAL REGION

EVERY EXISTING CRITERION HAD FAILED, AND THE PAPER LISTS THEM. Morphology: BOTH DISC-SHAPED AND STELLATE CELLS CAN BE GLUTAMATERGIC OR GABAERGIC, AN INDICATION THAT EACH OF THESE MORPHOLOGICAL GROUPS CONSISTS OF AT LEAST TWO NEURON TYPES

Tone responses: A COMPREHENSIVE STUDY SHOWED THAT THESE RESPONSES FORM A CONTINUUM AND CANNOT BE USED ON THEIR OWN TO DEFINE FUNCTIONALLY SIGNIFICANT GROUPS OF NEURONS. A category defeated by a measured continuum, not by disagreement

THE CLASS IS SEPARABLE AND INTERNALLY VARIABLE AT THE SAME TIME: ALTHOUGH STATISTICALLY DIFFERENT FROM THE GENERAL NEURONAL POPULATION IN THE IC AND SHOWING A TIGHTLY CLUSTERED SFA RATIO, THE INTRINSIC PHYSIOLOGY OF VIP NEURONS STILL SHOWED SOME LEVEL OF VARIABILITY

A LUMPING DECISION JUSTIFIED BY A NULL: RECORDINGS MADE FROM THE ICc, ICd, AND IClc WERE LUMPED TOGETHER FOR THIS EXPERIMENT BECAUSE THERE WERE NO CLEAR DIFFERENCES IN VIP NEURON PHYSIOLOGY ACROSS THESE SUBDIVISIONS OF THE IC. The pooling is declared and its reason is an absence
and the residual spread was followed rather than left as noise: WE THEREFORE HYPOTHESIZED THAT THE INTRINSIC PHYSIOLOGY OF VIP NEURONS IN THE ICc VARIED ALONG THE TONOTOPIC AXIS OF THE ICc
THE CLASS IS SMALL: VIP NEURONS REPRESENT 2.3% OF THE TOTAL POPULATION OF NEURONS IN THE MOUSE IC (208 OF 9304 NEURONS)
and the spininess that helps mark the class is not exclusive to it: DENDRITIC SPINES CAN BE PRESENT ON A VARIETY OF CELL TYPES, INCLUDING STELLATE AND DISC-SHAPED CELLS

THE TASK IS COPIED SO THAT THE RESULTS CAN BE COMPARED: using the identical task is what allows a direct comparison, because even small changes in task parameters may introduce substantial differences in neuronal responses and lead to different conclusions

AND THE WORKED EXAMPLE IS IN THE SAME PARAGRAPH: in a similar task, one study found nearly no color information in monkey prefrontal cortex where another found it, so the exact task design may determine what the neurons appear to encode

A MODEL'S SCOPE IS TESTED BY MOVING IT OFF THE SUBSTRATE IT WAS BUILT ON: the model rests solely on monkey electrophysiology and is thus implicitly tied to the layered columns of the neocortex, and it fits a non-layered avian area too

ONE COMPUTATION, TWO OPPOSITE OUTCOMES, AND THE PAPER SAYS SO: the same normalization that destroys information in one subpopulation creates it in another, which may appear counter-intuitive and contradictory
THE CRITERION DETERMINES THE POPULATION FOUND: more than half the significant delay neurons were significant only at load 2 or load 3, so testing at load 1 alone would have missed them
and the neurons that gain information at higher load were found only because the selection was widened, not because they were predicted

THE DATA FIT BOTH RIVAL FAMILIES IN DIFFERENT RESPECTS: graded within-hemifield allocation fits a continuous resource, hemispheric independence fits discrete slots, and a nuanced slots-and-averaging model accommodates both

SHARED COMPUTATION ACROSS UNSHARED ARCHITECTURE IS THE POINT: differently organised areas produce strikingly similar physiological responses, which is read as convergent evolution onto the same basic mechanisms and the same limits

and the second: where load was varied, THE AUDITORY STIMULI ALWAYS CO-VARIED WITH THE WM LOAD ACROSS CONDITIONS, so the differences COULD REFLECT DIFFERENCES IN ACTIVITY EVOKED BY DIFFERENT STIMULI RATHER THAN DIFFERENCES IN WM LOAD
and the question is left open in the introduction rather than assumed: THUS, IT IS STILL AN OPEN QUESTION WHETHER AC EXHIBITS PERSISTENT CHANGES IN NEURAL ACTIVITY RELATED TO AUDITORY WM

A RESULT THAT AGREES WITH ONE LITERATURE AND CONTRADICTS ANOTHER, ACROSS SPECIES AND METHOD: the WM-related activity WAS STIMULUS SPECIFIC, which CONFIRMS the stimulus-specificity revealed in fMRI STUDIES OF HUMANS BUT CONTRASTS WITH STUDIES OF NONHUMAN PRIMATES WHICH REPORTED STIMULUS-SPECIFICITY TO BE MISSING
and the limit on that very claim, in the next sentence: SINCE ONLY TWO TONES (1 AND 3 kHz) WERE TESTED, THE STIMULUS SELECTIVITY COULD NOT BE ASSESSED ACCURATELY

THE TIMING RUNS THE WRONG WAY FOR THE STANDARD STORY: differential latencies were SIGNIFICANTLY SHORTER IN CORE FIELDS OF AC THAN IN vlPFC, by about 100 ms, which IS DIFFICULT TO RECONCILE WITH THE NOTION THAT PFC EXERTS A TOP-DOWN MODULATION of activity in sensory cortex
and what was not looked at is listed: information could also be stored in SPATIOTEMPORAL ACTIVATION PATTERNS, SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY, OR RHYTHMIC ACTIVITIES, BUT THESE WERE NOT ANALYZED HERE
with the spatial reach of the measurement limiting the anatomical claim: WE CANNOT CLARIFY WHETHER OTHER FIELDS OF AC ARE ALSO INVOLVED, because the slow potentials CAN SPREAD OVER MILLIMETERS

and the hypothesis it supports is one whose existing evidence base the paper describes as indirect: the sensory-recruitment hypothesis HAS MAINLY BEEN BASED ON MULTIVARIATE ANALYSIS OF fMRI SIGNAL PATTERNS, thus ON A SIGNAL THAT IS ONLY INDIRECTLY RELATED TO BRAIN ACTIVITY, BUT NOT ON DIRECT MEASUREMENTS of electric activity in sensory cortex

and a rival hypothesis is left compatible rather than defeated: the results are ALSO COMPATIBLE WITH THE STATIC POPULATION CODING HYPOTHESIS, because WM-related activity was also seen IN NEURONS THAT DID NOT RESPOND TO THE TWO TONES

and so is the word TASK, which most papers leave undefined: an operation requiring the production of AN INTENTIONAL CONNECTION BETWEEN SOUNDS, OTHER CONTEXT-RELEVANT STIMULI, AND BEHAVIORAL ACTIONS, WHICH ARE EXECUTED BECAUSE SUBJECTS ARE MOTIVATED TO DO SO
with the scope of the conclusion bounded at the end: whether persistent activity changes ALSO SUPPORT STORAGE FOR EVEN LONGER PERIODS and other WM processes IS NOT CLEAR AND IS UNDER DEBATE

the two accounts of repetition priming, set out as alternatives: FACILITATION OF COMPONENT PROCESSES (repetition tunes the pathway that produces the response) against DIRECT STIMULUS-RESPONSE BINDING retrieved from episodic memory (instance theory, event file theory, action-trigger theory). The difference is whether anything is STORED about the pairing, or whether the machinery simply runs better the second time

the same task across species is an EQUIVALENCE CLAIM resting on declared adjustments: reward volume scaled to each species' normal consumption, tubing gauge changed, sound levels set above each species' own threshold
subjective category boundary is the 50% point of a fitted logistic, distinct from the experimenter's boundary, and it is what shifts between blocks
speed of switching is measured as the trial at which an exponential fit crosses chance, not as trials to criterion
valid trials exclude early withdrawals, so every performance figure is conditioned on the animal having waited out the sound

NON-UNIQUENESS IS DECLARED IN THE METHODS, BEFORE ANY RESULT: with many interacting parameters, alternative sets could reproduce similar results, and no model can be shown to provide a unique solution
which is only visible because the alternatives were built and reported rather than assumed away

TWO RESULTS FROM ONE MODEL WITH DIFFERENT EVIDENTIAL STATUS, AND THE PAPER GRADES THEM: for the hemispheric difference the parameter space was narrowed after the fact, and for the contralateral difference there were clear prior hypotheses predicting the parameters AND the direction, enabling much clearer conclusions
and the contralateral model changed only four parameters, chosen from the literature rather than from the data, against 28 hand-tuned and optimized for the other
with the hemispheric interpretation labelled model-derived predictions, because there were no clear pre-defined hypotheses

THE FITTED PARAMETER MAY BE ABSORBING AN ANATOMICAL artifact: cortical folding in the left hemisphere increases signal cancelation, so the parameter differences may be compensating for structure rather than reflecting function
A QUANTITY THAT WAS NOT FITTED IS USED AS VALIDATION: firing rates were not part of the fitting procedure and land within physiological ranges, which is offered as further support

THE SAME TEST ON SIMULATED AND ON RECORDED DATA IS NOT THE SAME OBJECT: the reduced variability of simulations means the statistics are not directly comparable, and they are reported anyway for the qualitative features
and the simulations are smoothed specifically so that a comparison can be made at all, a transform applied to one side of it
A NON-SIGNIFICANT TREND BECOMES A MODELLED MECHANISM: latency differences did not reach significance, and a 5 ms shift was put into the model and captured the trend well

THE CANONICAL ASSUMPTION IS GRANTED WITH ITS EXCEPTION STATED: auditory connectivity is less well understood, laminar differences are less prominent than in visual or somatosensory cortex, and layer IV may play a different role

THE HEADLINE MECHANISM IS DECLARED UNTESTED, IN THE PAPER'S OWN DISCUSSION: ALTHOUGH THE CAUSALITY OR EVEN THE CONTRIBUTION OF THE PROPOSED ROLES OF PVs, SOMs, AND VIPs AND RECOVERED A1 SOUND PROCESSING WERE NOT TESTED HERE, THEY WILL BE EVALUATED IN FUTURE WORK

and a third time, inside the sentence that states the conclusion: OUR OBSERVATIONS ARE CONSISTENT WITH THE NOTION, ALBEIT NOT TESTED HERE, THAT PVs ACT AS THE STABILIZERS, WHEREAS SOMs ACT AS THE MODULATORS OF A1 PLASTICITY. Three declarations of the same limit, in three places, on the claim the title carries

and the regime that makes the model's conclusions follow is an assumption whose truth is open: THE ASSUMPTION THAT CORTICAL INHIBITION IS NEEDED TO PREVENT PATHOLOGIC ACTIVITY PLACES THE MODEL IN THE ISN (ISN) REGIME, and IT REMAINS AN OPEN QUESTION WHETHER THE CORTEX LIES IN THE ISN REGIME WITH INHIBITION ACTIVELY PREVENTING UNSTABLE DYNAMICS BY BALANCING EXCITATION OR IS SIMPLY WIRED TO RESIST INSTABILITY

TWO IMAGING METHODS, SAME RULE, DIFFERENT SIZE: WIDE-FIELD IMAGING SHOWED LARGER SHIFTS AND REDUCED RECOVERY IN THE RESPONSE THRESHOLDS COMPARED TO THE 2P IMAGING, because WIDE-FIELD IMAGING ASSESSES RESPONSES FROM DIFFERENT NEURONAL COMPARTMENTS (SOMATA AND DENDRITES) AND DIFFERENT CORTICAL LAYERS

WHAT RECOVERS IS NOT WHAT MATTERS: COMPENSATORY A1 PLASTICITY LIKELY SUPPORTS THE RECOVERY OF THE PERCEPTUAL SOUND-DETECTION THRESHOLD BUT DOES NOT SUPPORT SOUND PROCESSING ENCODED BY PRECISE SPIKE TIMING, SUCH AS MODULATED NOISE OR SPEECH, AND RESTRICTS HEARING IN A NOISY ENVIRONMENT

and the cell that carries that ability is the one that goes down: A1 SOMs, WHICH ARE CRITICALLY IMPORTANT FOR SOUND PROCESSING ENCODED BY PRECISE SPIKE TIMING OF NEURONAL FIRING, SHOWED REDUCED SOUND-EVOKED ACTIVITY AFTER NIHL

and it does separate them: NOISE EXPOSURE SIGNIFICANTLY REDUCED THE NUMBER OF RIBBON SYNAPSES PER IHC IN THE HIGH-FREQUENCY REGION (16-32 kHz) OF THE COCHLEA, WITHOUT AFFECTING THE SURVIVAL OF EITHER IHCs OR OHCs

THE CIRCUIT THE INTERPRETATION RESTS ON IS IMPORTED, NOT MEASURED HERE: BASED ON THE KNOWN SEQUENTIALLY ORGANIZED INHIBITORY CORTICAL NETWORK, WHERE VIPs NEURONS INHIBIT SOMs, SOMs INHIBIT PVs AND PNs, AND PVs INHIBIT OTHER PVs AND PNs

and the reason one class rather than another is cast as the stabiliser is an argument from symmetry: PNs AND PVs ARE EMBEDDED INTO VERY SIMILAR SYNAPTIC ENVIRONMENTS... THIS SYMMETRY PLACES PVs IN A STRATEGIC POSITION FOR MONITORING AND STABILIZING PN ACTIVITY

and the peripheral damage persists while the cortex recovers: NOISE EXPOSURE SIGNIFICANTLY INCREASED THE ABR RESPONSE THRESHOLDS FOR 8-32 kHz TONES, WHICH REMAINED ELEVATED EVEN 10 DAYS AFTER NOISE EXPOSURE
AND THE RULE IS STATED AS A RULE: confusion arises when the same anatomic term applies to different areas in different species, and ANATOMIC TERMS SHOULD MEAN THE SAME THING ACROSS SPECIES
THE WHOLE CONTROVERSY IS ABOUT WORDS, AND THEY SAY SO: three reasons, ALL OF WHICH REFLECT CONFUSION ABOUT ANATOMIC NOMENCLATURE AND NOT ACTUAL PHYSICAL OR PHYSIOLOGIC ISSUES
AND THREE ACRONYMS FOR ONE AREA: PL, PrL and Cg3 all name the prelimbic cortex, with the paper wishing A SINGLE SET OF ANATOMIC TERMS were used
THE ATLAS ITSELF ADMITS IT, ON PAGE XV: THE NOMENCLATURE OF THE RODENT CINGULATE CORTEX AND RELATED AREAS HAS BEEN A MAJOR PROBLEM FOR SOME DECADES
AND THE PUBLISHED FIX WAS IGNORED, WITH THE RATIO COUNTED: 279 publications use the superseded term in their title and FOUR use the corrected one

term_head_mismatches.head: **AND THE CROSS-SPECIES RESULT IS A DIFFERENCE, NOT A CONFIRMATION:** `First, in mice, the priming effect is in SUCCESS RATES and not in response times, whereas in humans, the priming effect is BOTH in success rates and response times.` So it is not that the two species use different measures

examples.label: **AND THE CROSS-SPECIES RESULT IS A DIFFERENCE, NOT A CONFIRMATION:** `First, in mice, the priming effect is in SUCCESS RATES and not in response times, whereas in humans, the priming effect is BOTH in success rates and response times.` So it is not that the two species use different measures - **humans show the effect in both channels and mice show it in only one.** A weaker paper would have reported that priming generalises to mice; this one reports which measure it lands in and that the human pattern is strictly larger. The concept survives the species change and its operationalisation does not, which is exactly the case a controlled vocabulary handles worst: both would be tagged `priming effect` and the tag would hide the disagreement. **I first quoted the figure caption for this, which says only `in humans, the typical priming effect is in response time` - the looser claim. The discussion is more precise than the caption and I had taken the caption as the paper's position**

term_head_mismatches.head: **THE DEFINITION IS THE RARE THING HERE.** `Priming, a change in the mental processing of a stimulus as a result of prior encounter with a RELATED stimulus, has been observed repeatedly and studied extensively in humans.` Most of this corpus assumes the term and argues about mechanisms

examples.label: **THE DEFINITION IS THE RARE THING HERE.** `Priming, a change in the mental processing of a stimulus as a result of prior encounter with a RELATED stimulus, has been observed repeatedly and studied extensively in humans.` Most of this corpus assumes the term and argues about mechanisms - meyer1971 contains the word zero times, neely1977 uses it only in its title and running headers. **A paper extending a concept to a new species has to say what the concept is**, and that pressure is why the definition exists at all

term_head_mismatches.head: **THE MECHANISM CLAIM IS ASYMMETRIC AND THE PAPER SAYS SO RATHER THAN LETTING THE MEASURE IMPLY IT:** `the addition of INCONGRUENT prime stimuli reduces success rate MORE THAN congruent prime stimuli, suggesting a cognitive mechanism based on DIFFERENTIAL INTERFERENCE.` Both prime types cost performance against unprimed trials; the incongruent ones cost more. So the priming effect here is **a difference between two costs, not a benefit over a baseline**

examples.label: **THE MECHANISM CLAIM IS ASYMMETRIC AND THE PAPER SAYS SO RATHER THAN LETTING THE MEASURE IMPLY IT:** `the addition of INCONGRUENT prime stimuli reduces success rate MORE THAN congruent prime stimuli, suggesting a cognitive mechanism based on DIFFERENTIAL INTERFERENCE.` Both prime types cost performance against unprimed trials; the incongruent ones cost more. `13 different types of plant diseases` - BOUNDED TO WHAT IS VISUALLY DIAGNOSABLE FROM A LEAF. The scope is set by what a photograph of a leaf can show, not by what matters agronomically, and the authors state that bound

`87.1%` - a percentage of 1,582 reads, which are what remained of 10,038,758 after human sequence was filtered out. The denominator of the headline proportion is the SURVIVORS OF A FILTER, not the sample

`a conspiracist belief` - defined by quotation from a JOURNALIST'S BOOK: `THE UNNECESSARY ASSUMPTION OF CONSPIRACY WHEN OTHER EXPLANATIONS ARE MORE PROBABLE`. The definition contains its own verdict, and the scale that follows does not measure whether the assumption was unnecessary

`acute kidney injury (renal-replacement sense)` - THE RIVAL DEFINITION THE PAPER NAMES: `our study highlights the potential for UNDER-REPORTING WHEN RENAL REPLACEMENT THERAPY IS USED TO 'DEFINE' ACUTE KIDNEY INJURY`. Under RIFLE 28% reach class F; only 14% of those are dialysed

`acute kidney injury (RIFLE sense)` - meeting ANY of the RIFLE criteria: serum creatinine risen 1.5x, 2x or 3x from baseline, OR urine output below a stated rate for a stated number of hours, `both ABRUPT (WITHIN 1-7 DAYS) AND SUSTAINED (MORE THAN 24 HOURS)`
`acute renal failure` (before RIFLE) - MORE THAN THIRTY DEFINITIONS in the literature, with incidence reported from 1% to 25% and mortality from 28% to 90% depending on which was used
`acute` / `delayed` / `persistent` - PGD subtypes defined purely by WHEN the symptom criteria are met (0-6 mo, 6-12 mo, or both), with no reference to severity or content

`antibody response duration` - CONTESTED, and the contest is partly instrumental: studies using `PAN-Ig` ASSAYS THAT CANNOT EVALUATE EACH ISOTYPE SEPARATELY report no decrease; isotype-resolved measurement finds one from the first month
`at risk` - the output of step one, established `BY THE USE OF ANY VALIDATED SCREENING TOOL`; the definition deliberately does not name which

`atomic energy contribution` - A QUANTITY WITH NO UNIQUE PHYSICAL DEFINITION, GIVEN ONE BY A PROCEDURE. The paper concedes `THE INTRINSIC NON-UNIQUENESS OF ATOMIC ENERGY PARTITIONING`, notes that in quantum chemistry `EVERY MOLECULE WOULD CORRESPOND TO A DIFFERENT PARTITIONING`, and then defines it as whatever the model learns - `A TRANSFERABLE AND GLOBAL DRESSED ATOM REPRESENTATION`
`Balanced ANI Score` - `0.5 x (ANI score) + 0.5 x (quality score)`, the rule deciding when the genome a species name points at may be swapped

`benchmark` (GIAB sense) - a set of high-confidence calls published so that `ANYONE CAN BENCHMARK ACCURACY OF THEIR CALLS for these genomes`. Correctness distributed as a file, alongside the DNA it came from

`blacklist` - A PUBLISHED CONTROLLED LIST OF WHAT DOES NOT COUNT, and removing it is `AN ESSENTIAL QUALITY MEASURE`. Not a recommendation: ENCODE filters every ChIP-seq dataset with it and uses the proportion of reads it catches as A QUALITY CONTROL METRIC FOR THE EXPERIMENT

`breakthrough` - OPERATIONALLY, WINNING A BENCHMARK: `AlexNet is considered to be a breakthrough in the field of DL AS IT WON the ImageNet challenge for object recognition KNOWN AS ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge (ILSVRC) in the year 2012`

`caseness` - not a clinical fact but a constructed standard: a dichotomised item-response-model score on the 12 surviving symptoms, cut at the point of `greatest agreement (kappa = 0.68)` with rater judgement

`CC1/2` - the correlation coefficient between two random half data sets; preferred because a correlation coefficient `HAS A WELL DEFINED RANGE`, and a descendant of Fourier shell correlation from 1980s electron microscopy

`character` - `any property or feature of the virus`, including genome composition, capsid structure, envelopment, gene expression programme, HOST RANGE, PATHOGENICITY and sequence similarity. AND ONE FAMILY OF CHARACTERS HAS WON: `sequence comparisons ... HAVE BECOME ONE OF THE PRIMARY SETS OF CHARACTERS used to define and distinguish virus taxa`

`circular ratio (CR)` - the fraction of junction reads at one end of an exon that are back-spliced: `CR=number of circular reads/(number of circular reads+number of linear reads)`. THE CIRCLE IS DEFINED RELATIVE TO ITS OWN LINEAR COMPETITOR
`ciRS-7` = `CDR1as` - THE SAME MOLECULE UNDER TWO NAMES, given in apposition: `the circRNA ciRS-7 (ALSO TERMED CDR1as)`. One of the two cue shapes the gate can read

`complete proteome` - JUDGED AGAINST THE NEIGHBOURS RATHER THAN AGAINST THE ORGANISM: the CPD compares each proteome `TO THOSE OF A GROUP OF AT LEAST THREE CLOSELY TAXONOMICALLY RELATED SPECIES` and returns `standard`, `close to standard` or `outlier`

`complete renal recovery` vs `partial renal recovery` - both defined by reference to the RIFLE classification itself: return to baseline class, or a persistent change in class without persistent need for renal replacement

`computability` and `effective calculability` - EQUIVALENT IN EXTENSION AND UNRELATED IN CONSTRUCTION, and Turing says both halves in one clause: Church's idea `IS EQUIVALENT TO MY "COMPUTABILITY", BUT IS VERY DIFFERENTLY DEFINED`. Two names picking out the same class of functions by definitions that share nothing.
`concept` (Deleuze and Guattari, adapted) - a multiplicity whose components are `distinct, heterogeneous and, yet, not separable`, and `there is NO CONCEPT WITH ONLY ONE COMPONENT`
`conceptual framework` (this paper) - `a network, or a plane, of interlinked concepts that together provide a comprehensive understanding of a phenomenon`
`conceptual framework` vs `model` - the first is built on concepts, the second on variables or factors; the paper stipulates the split to stop loose usage

`consistent` - USED HERE FOR TWO NUMBERS THAT DIFFER BY NEARLY A FACTOR OF TWO. 4.7% with major depressive disorder with severe impairment against 8.5% with depression symptoms, same country, adjacent years, and the paper calls the pair consistent BECAUSE IT NAMES THE CONSTRUCT DIFFERENCE. This is the correct use of the word and it is rare
`content` (of an intervention) - its `ACTIVE INGREDIENTS`: `the drug, treatment, skills, or knowledge that the intervention seeks to deliver to its recipients`

`continuously evolving AI systems` - `ALSO KNOWN AS continuously adapting or continuously learning AI systems`. Three names for one concept, recorded in the sentence that excludes it from the vocabulary

`conversely` - the word doing the work in `factors modulating vaccine confidence AND, CONVERSELY, HESITANCY`. It treats the two as opposite ends of one axis, which is precisely what macdonald2015 argued they are not: confidence is one of three categories of hesitancy determinant, not its inverse

`core microbiome` (this paper) - THE 1660 UNIQUE SEQUENCES PRESENT IN ALL THREE SAMPLED INDIVIDUALS, contributing 66% of reads; an intersection, so its size is a function of how many people were sequenced
`correct name` - LPSN's current judgement, published alongside `THE CONDITIONS UNDER WHICH A NAME WOULD BE REGARDED AS THE CORRECT NAME IF IT IS NOT CURRENTLY SO REGARDED`
`crossover interaction` (EPIDEMIOLOGY) - the same effect-reversal ecology now calls `mitigating synergism`, and there it is `THE MOST STATISTICALLY ROBUST CLASS OF INTERACTION`

`crowded` AS AGAINST `concentrated` - TWO NAMES FOR ONE MILIEU, WITH THE CRITERION STATED: media are `KNOWN AS CROWDED RATHER THAN CONCENTRATED environments, as, IN GENERAL, NO INDIVIDUAL MACROMOLECULAR SPECIES MAY BE PRESENT AT HIGH CONCENTRATION`. High total, low per-species - and the second word would imply the opposite

`crowding agent` - A POLYMER STANDING IN FOR A CROWD, in the paper's own scare quotes: `concentrated solutions of various polymers that serve as MODEL CROWDING AGENTS`. A single-species concentrated solution used to model precisely the thing the paper distinguishes from a concentrated solution

`cultural competency` (Cross et al. 1989) - `a set of congruent behaviours, attitudes, and policies that come together in a system, agency, or among professionals` enabling effective work in cross-cultural situations
`cultural competency` (individual framing) - the ability of INDIVIDUALS to establish working relationships that supersede cultural differences
`cultural competency` (systems framing) - the ability of SYSTEMS to provide care to patients with diverse values, tailoring delivery to their needs
`cultural safety` (Nursing Council of NZ 1992) - `a focus for the delivery of quality care through changes in thinking about POWER RELATIONSHIPS and patients' rights`
`cultural safety` (this paper's proposal) - examined bias, ongoing self-reflection and accountability, `AS DEFINED BY THE PATIENT AND THEIR COMMUNITIES` and measured by progress towards health equity

`danger signal` - split into two by ORIGIN rather than by structure: `(a) DAMAGE-ASSOCIATE MOLECULAR PATTERNS (DAMPs), i.e., molecules released by stress cells undergoing necrosis` and `(b) PATHOGEN-ASSOCIATED MOLECULAR PATTERNS (PAMPs), which are pathogen-specific molecules NOT FOUND IN THE HOST`. The receptor cannot tell them apart; the definition is about where the molecule came from
`data saturation` - informational redundancy, judged at the level of data collection and separated from analysis and from theory

`detected`, AS OPERATIONALISED HERE - what survives a method that AVERAGES alignment quality instead of THRESHOLDING it. `A thousand published studies` used the thresholded algorithms and the class `HAD ELUDED DETECTION`
`Development environment` versus `Operational environment` - the pair that carries the generalisation claim: the settings the training data came from, against the settings the system is deployed into

`developmentally equivalent` - UNDEFINED BY THE FIELD AND FILLED BY CONVENTION: `THERE IS NO EXACT DEFINITION OF THE MINIMUM TIME for detecting developmental effects across scans, though designs TYPICALLY SPAN AT LEAST 3-6 MONTHS`

`digital transformation` AS A KIND - `a process of DEEP, STRUCTURAL CHANGE that occurs through the integration of multiple technologies and FUNDAMENTALLY REDEFINES ORGANIZATIONAL VALUE AND IDENTITY`. A third characterisation in the same paragraph as the other two

`digital transformation` AS DEFINED - `a process that AIMS TO IMPROVE AN ENTITY BY TRIGGERING SIGNIFICANT CHANGES TO ITS PROPERTIES THROUGH COMBINATIONS OF INFORMATION, COMPUTING, COMMUNICATION, AND CONNECTIVITY TECHNOLOGIES`. A definition with one hedge doing all the work - `SIGNIFICANT`

`digital transformation` AS DISTINGUISHED - not by kind but by three magnitudes: `in contrast to other forms of technological change, digital transformation DIFFERS IN TERMS OF ITS SCALE, SPEED, AND SCOPE`. The class boundary is three comparatives with no threshold

`entertainment` (2001) - one category holding both light and dark human interest; split here into entertainment and drama

`filler` - ONE WORD, TWO DISJOINT SENSES, IN ONE SENTENCE. `INERT FILLERS are materials that are used to modify the strength, working and flow properties, and shrinkage of plastics, WHILE the reinforcing ones, ALSO CALLED FILLERS, are defined as those with some strength properties that are SIGNIFICANTLY SUPERIOR to those of the base resin`. The second sense claims the bare word that the first also uses
`gambling related harm` (New Zealand Gambling Act 2003) - `any kind of harm or distress arising from, or caused or EXACERBATED BY, a person's gambling`

`gestational diabetes` (concept) - `ANY DEGREE OF GLUCOSE INTOLERANCE WITH ONSET OR FIRST RECOGNITION DURING PREGNANCY`, and this part `IS LARGELY ACCEPTED`
`gestational diabetes` (IADPSG sense) - fasting >= 5.1, one hour >= 10.0, or two hours >= 8.5 mmol/L, derived from the HAPO study AND BASED ON PREGNANCY OUTCOMES rather than on a distribution

`gestational diabetes` (WHO sense) - the 2 h 75 g OGTT with the cut points used OUTSIDE pregnancy: fasting >= 7 mmol/l or 2 h plasma glucose >= 7.8 mmol/l, encompassing impaired glucose tolerance and diabetes

`health literacy` (this paper's synthesis) - `people's KNOWLEDGE, MOTIVATION AND COMPETENCES TO ACCESS, UNDERSTAND, APPRAISE, AND APPLY HEALTH INFORMATION` in healthcare, disease prevention and health promotion, across the life course

`Health outcome` and `Clinical outcome` - TWO GLOSSARY ENTRIES WITH ONE DEFINITION, differing only in `that` versus `which`. Either they are the same concept named twice, or a distinction the authors intended did not survive into the text
`healthy` (as operationalised here) - no pockets deeper than 3 mm and bleeding at no more than 10% of gingival sites, against a literature convention of `LESS THAN 20-25%`

`heavy metal` - THREE COMPETING DEFINITIONS IN FOUR SENTENCES, THE SECOND REFUTED BY ITS OWN EXTENSION: density `at least 5 g/cm-3`; OR `an atomic mass higher than 23 or an atomic number exceeding 20`; and then `THESE DEFINITIONS ARE CONFUSING AND MISLEADING DUE TO THE FACT THAT THEY CAUSE THE INCLUSION OF NON-METALS`

`high` (of a postoperative temperature) - `some surgeons INCLUDED A BODY TEMPERATURE GREATER THAN 38 C ON TWO CONSECUTIVE DAYS as being `high`, WHEREAS OTHERS` counted an entirely different set of events. The word survived; the referent did not

`ileus` / `small bowel obstruction` / `colon obstruction` - THREE REPORTING NAMES FOR ONE EVENT, and the paper's reason for existing: `under such circumstances, THE INCIDENCE OF THIS AE CANNOT BE COUNTED ACCURATELY`
`immune-related adverse event` - bounded by a reporting window that differs between studies, and with a class of late events that falls outside all of them
`indel` - AND WHETHER A GIVEN ONE IS AN INSERTION OR A DELETION DEPENDS ON THE ALIGNER: `BWA ANNOTATES INDELS PREFERENTIALLY AS DELETIONS, AND GraphMap FAVORS INSERTIONS`

examples.label: `inflammation phase` AS THE BODY USES IT - `CONCURRENT WITH HAEMOSTASIS`, lasting `2-5 days`, and named for a response that `CONTINUES THROUGH THE WHOLE PROCEDURE OF WOUND HEALING`. Concurrent with the phase before it, overlapping the phase after it, and outlived by its own defining property

`intrinsic functional connectivity` - operationalised down to a coordinate and a diameter: `the mean time series from a SPHERICAL REGION OF INTEREST (DIAMETER=8 MM) CENTERED IN PCC` and `Pearson's correlation ... Fisher r-to-z transformed`

`IRES` / `cap-independent translation` - A MECHANISM NAMED IN VIRUSES AND THEN CARRIED INTO CELL BIOLOGY. `Cap-independent translation, driven by THE SO-CALLED IRES, WAS INITIALLY DESCRIBED IN VIRAL RNAs (Pelletier and Sonenberg, 1988) AND SUBSEQUENTLY IDENTIFIED ALSO IN CELLULAR RNAs.` **`so-called` is the paper keeping its distance from the name while using it**, and the sentence records the term's migration between two literatures in the order it happened. The later, cellular sense inherits a definition fixed on viral evidence.
`legacy harm` - harm that continues or emerges after engagement with gambling ceases; the label exists to mark that harm does not end with the behaviour
`literacy` (the head noun) - `FAMILIAR WITH LITERATURE` or `WELL EDUCATED, LEARNED` for most of its history, and only in the late nineteenth century `THE ABILITIES TO READ AND WRITE TEXT`

`low-quality cell` - OPERATIONALLY, WHATEVER THE OUTLIER DETECTOR MARKS. The paper gives examples (`low total counts and few expressed genes`) and then says the method is `SOMEWHAT OPAQUE WITH RESPECT TO HOW OUTLIERS ARE DEFINED`. A class defined by its detector, with the detector declining to say what it detects

examples.label: `low-quality cell` IN THE OTHER SENSE THE SAME PAPER USES - A CELL THAT DIED OR WHOSE PROTOCOL FAILED: `a high percentage of counts mapping to spike-ins typically indicates that a small amount of RNA was captured for the cell, SUGGESTING PROTOCOL FAILURE OR DEATH OF THE CELL`. The first sense is statistical, the second is biological, and the exclusion is justified by the second while performed by the first

`M1` / `M2` - TWO MACROPHAGE CLASSES DEFINED BY FUNCTIONAL PHENOTYPE, `defined by their DISTINCT FUNCTIONAL PHENOTYPES`, whose members `can READILY SWITCH FROM ONE FUNCTIONAL PHENOTYPE TO ANOTHER`. A classification of things that change class

`malnutrition` (GLIM) - at least ONE phenotypic criterion (weight loss, low BMI, reduced muscle mass) AND at least ONE etiologic criterion (reduced intake or assimilation, inflammation or disease burden)
`MDSC` (2007 coinage) - a term chosen for `THE MYELOID ORIGIN, THE IMMUNE-SUPPRESSIVE FUNCTION AND THE SYSTEMIC EXPANSION`, explicitly NOT a claim about a distinct lineage
`medical` / `patient` / `clinical health literacy` - three names for the individual cognitive-skills tradition, framed by Nutbeam as a `CLINICAL RISK` approach

`microbiome` (Lederberg, THE MOST CITED) - `a community of commensal, symbiotic, and pathogenic microorganisms WITHIN A BODY SPACE OR OTHER ENVIRONMENT` - ecological, host-centred, and not the original

`microbiome` (Whipps et al. 1988, revived here) - `a CHARACTERISTIC MICROBIAL COMMUNITY occupying a reasonable well-defined habitat which has DISTINCT PHYSIO-CHEMICAL PROPERTIES ... not only refers to the microorganisms involved but also ENCOMPASS THEIR THEATRE OF ACTIVITY`
`misclassification` - contested in this paper: an assignment the expert panel rejects may still be correct under the criterion the classifier declares

`mitigating synergism` (new here) - `two stressors operating in the same direction create a cumulative effect COMPLETELY OPPOSITE to what would have been predicted`: two positives make a negative, or two negatives make a positive

`more aromatic` - AROMATICITY USED AS A SCALAR, IN SCARE QUOTES. `the DTNN model predicts the C6O3H6 molecule to be MORE AROMATIC than benzene or toluene`, and the paper reports the model grasps `DIFFERENT DEGREES OF AROMATICITY`. A property usually taught as a yes/no becomes a ranking because the model produces one

`MR Egger regression` - allows pleiotropic effects `AS LONG AS THE SIZE OF THESE PLEIOTROPIC EFFECTS IS INDEPENDENT OF THE SIZE OF THE GENETIC VARIANTS' EFFECTS ON THE RISK FACTOR` - a violation permitted under a condition
`neutralizing activity` - measured two ways that do not agree: a cell-culture neutralization assay and an RBD-ACE2 blocking assay, the latter `LESS SENSITIVE` for named mechanistic reasons
`news` - as practitioners define it: `I know it when I see it`, `Because it just is!`, a gut feeling that obscures as much as it reveals

`normal value` - IN THIS PAPER, THE MEAN +/- 1.96 SD OF A WORKING POPULATION, 0.78 to 3.53. Not a physiological threshold, not an outcome-derived cut-off: a distribution of people who were at work and had blood taken

term_head_mismatches.head: `normal value` IN THE LITERATURE IT CORRECTS
